best_lineage.idea: Replace the naive i-j-k triple loop with a cache-friendly i-k-j order that streams rows of B and C, uses NEON 4-wide FMA (vfmaq_f32) for the inner loop, zero-initializes each C row (caller fills C with garbage), and parallelizes over row blocks with std::thread (capped at 10 cores). Handles any n from 1 to 2048 via scalar tails.
